blocks.text: Pichhli classes mein aap ne “levels of biological organization” (jandaron ki tarteeb ke darjay) parhe thay. Wahan biological molecules ka mukhtasar taaruf (introduction) mila tha. Ab hum carbohydrates, proteins, lipids aur nucleic acids ko tafseel se parhenge, aur saath hi pani ki ahmiyat aur conjugated molecules ka kirdar (role) bhi dekhenge.

Biochemistry jandaron (living organisms) ke chemical components aur un ke andar hone wale chemical processes ka ilm hai. Jandaron ki har structure ek biochemical tarteeb (organization) se bani hai, aur un ke saare kaam (functions) isi tarteeb mein hone wale biochemical processes ki wajah se hote hain. Is liye biochemistry ki bunyadi samajh se anatomy (jism ki banawat) aur physiology (jism ke kaam) samajhna asaan ho jata hai. Photosynthesis, respiration (saans aur tawanai ka nikalna), digestion (hazma) aur contraction (sukarna) waghaira sab ko biochemical alfaaz mein bayan kiya ja sakta hai.

blocks.title: Yaad karein
blocks.text: Jandar ki zindagi us ke cells mein bina ruke hone wali chemical activities par chalti hai. Cell ke andar hone wale saare chemical reactions ko mila kar metabolism kehte hain. Metabolism ke processes do qisam ke hain: anabolism, jis mein saada (simple) cheezein mil kar complex (pecheeda) cheezein banati hain; aur catabolism, jis mein complex molecules toot kar saada molecules bante hain.

Zameen par zindagi pani mein shuru hui, aur aaj bhi har zindagi pani par depend karti hai. Jandaron ke mass (protoplasm) ka kam az kam 80% pani hai, aur zindagi ke taqreeban saare chemical reactions aqueous solutions (pani wale mahlool) mein hote hain. Jandaron ko banane wale baqi chemicals zyada tar organic macromolecules aur kuch inorganic molecules hain. Jo molecules cells khud banate hain aur jin mein carbon hota hai, unhein organic molecules kehte hain. Yeh qudrati taur par sirf jandaron ke jism mein, ya un ki products aur remains (baqiyat) mein milte hain. Carbohydrates, proteins, lipids aur nucleic acids jandaron ke aham organic molecules hain. Yeh jandaron ke dry mass (pani nikalne ke baad bacha wazan) ka 93% banate hain (Table 4.1). Baqi 7% chhote organic molecules (jaise vitamins) aur inorganic molecules (jaise carbon dioxide, acids, bases aur salts) hain.

Organic molecules ka core (bunyadi dhancha) carbon se bana hota hai aur us se atoms ke kuch khaas groups jure hote hain. In groups ko functional groups kehte hain, maslan OH, CO, COOH, NH₂ waghaira. Zyada tar biochemical reactions mein ya to ek functional group ek molecule se doosre molecule par jata (transfer hota) hai, ya carbon-carbon bond toot-ta hai.

blocks.caption: Table 4.1: Protoplasm ke dry mass mein bare organic molecules ka %

blocks.text: Zyada tar organic molecules size mein bare hote hain, is liye biologists unhein macromolecules (bare molecules) kehte hain. Bohat se macromolecules polymers ki shakal mein hote hain. Polymer aisa molecule hai jo bohat si ek jaisi chhoti units se bana ho; in units ko monomers kehte hain. Carbohydrates, proteins aur nucleic acids jaise aham macromolecules saada monomers ke polymers hain: carbohydrates sugars ke, proteins amino acids ke aur nucleic acids nucleotides ke.

blocks.caption: Chaar bunyadi biological molecules aur un ke monomers
rows: Asal polymer nahin; glycerol aur fatty acids jaisi units se bante hain

blocks.prompt: Kaun sa group protoplasm ke dry mass ka aadha banata hai, aur us ka monomer kya hai? Chaar groups mein se kaun sa ek hi monomer ke dohrane se bana polymer nahin?
blocks.explanation: Proteins dry mass ka 50% (yani aadha) banate hain; un ke monomers amino acids hain. Lipids ek hi monomer ke dohrane se bane polymers nahin; yeh glycerol aur fatty acids jaisi units se bante hain.

items: Biochemistry jandaron ke chemical components aur chemical processes ka ilm hai; protoplasm ka kam az kam 80% pani hai aur zindagi ke reactions pani mein hote hain.

Organic molecules mein carbon hota hai aur inhein cells banate hain. Carbohydrates, proteins, lipids aur nucleic acids dry mass ka 93% hain (proteins 50, nucleic acids 18, carbohydrates 15, lipids 10); baqi 7% vitamins jaise chhote organic aur inorganic molecules.
Metabolism = anabolism (saada se complex banana) + catabolism (complex ko saada mein torna). Macromolecules aksar monomers ke polymers hain: sugars, amino acids, nucleotides.
